introHtml: Poly propylene lip balm tubes are a practical choice for bulk promotional orders. Unlike softer plastics, poly propylene resists cracking and holds up in pockets or giveaway bags. The material accepts vibrant imprint colors well, making your logo stand out. Safety managers and HR directors often choose these for outdoor crews or employee wellness kits because the durable tube survives daily use. Perfect for trade shows, corporate events, or seasonal giveaways, these lip balms keep your brand visible without breaking the budget.
